name: Portland
lede: Portland, across the bay from Corpus Christi, runs a season long Christmas on the Coast with a real ice skating rink at Fifth & Elm, Tuesday holiday movies on the lawn, a tree lighting, a Parade of Lights and Breakfast with Santa.
celebrates: The City of Portland decks out its facilities with lights, garland, a Christmas tree and picture worthy decorations, and calls the season Christmas on the Coast. The calendar opens with real ice at Fifth & Elm on November 27 and Merry Movies on the Lawn every Tuesday. The mayor lights a giant city tree at the Portland Community Center on December 5, Santa rides the Parade of Lights on December 7 and families can book Breakfast with Santa on December 12. Nearby Ingleside, Aransas Pass and Sinton add their own parades and Santa mornings, and we list those here too.
lastyear: Portland's Christmas on the Coast was already a city tradition before 2026, with the city's special events page listing Christmas on the Coast, the Parade of Lights, Pooch-a-Palooza and Santa and a Toy Drive as recurring events. Over in Aransas Pass, the chamber's archive shows the Illuminated Saltwater Christmas Parade ran on December 4, 2025. This year the ice rink moves to the city's Fifth & Elm.
facts: The ice rink at Fifth & Elm is real ice, not synthetic, according to the City of Portland, and sessions last 2 hours with skate rental included. The Parade of Lights is a single loop of about 1.8 miles that passes Gregory-Portland Middle School. Christmas trees in the Christmas Tree Forest are donated afterward to families in need through Christmas for Kids Year Round, and the Toy Drive and Fill the Truck night aim to fill the city truck bed with toys.
trains: We did not find a train ride in Portland itself. The closest your family gets to a train this season is The Polar Express movie night on the Great Lawn at Fifth & Elm on Tuesday, December 22, according to the City of Portland. For real rail history and rides, see the Texas train museums and rides guide on our site and our Corpus Christi page.
traditions: Real ice skating at Fifth & Elm
A 2 hour skate session with rental included, from November 27 to January 3.
Holiday movies every Tuesday with crafts and guest appearances from Santa and the Grinch.
The giant city tree is lit at the Portland Community Center on December 5.
Santa rides an illuminated route of about 1.8 miles on December 7.
Decorated trees that visitors vote on and that are donated to families in need.
New unwrapped toys go to Christmas for Kids Year Round.
kidfact: Portland has real ice for skating at Christmas, and the Parade of Lights loops about 1.8 miles around town.
faq: The City of Portland holds Christmas on the Coast with real ice skating at Fifth & Elm, Merry Movies on the Lawn, a tree lighting at the Community Center, a Parade of Lights, Breakfast with Santa and a Christmas Tree Forest. The city decorates its facilities with lights and garland for the whole season.
Is there a free Christmas event in Portland?
Yes. The movie nights, the December 5 tree lighting and the Parade of Lights are listed as free by the City of Portland. Ice skating and Breakfast with Santa have a price.
Can kids meet Santa in Portland?
Yes. Santa is at the tree lighting celebration, at Breakfast with Santa, at Pooch-A-Palooza for dogs and in the Parade of Lights, according to the city.
Where is the ice rink in Portland?
At the City of Portland's Fifth & Elm, 201 5th St, Portland, TX 78374. Tickets are sold online only.
Which nearby towns are on this page?
Ingleside, Aransas Pass and Sinton fold into this page because each has only one or two events this year.
sources: Visit Portland Texas, City of Portland
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Portland for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 8 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the Real Ice Skating Rink at Fifth & Elm) through January 3, with the Illuminated Saltwater Christmas Parade in Aransas Pass (December 3), the Tree Lighting and Christmas in Portland Celebration (December 5) and the Portland Parade of Lights (December 7) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Portland

  • 11 Christmas events for kids in Portland, including nearby Ingleside, Aransas Pass and Sinton
  • 8 free events, including Merry Movies on the Lawn, the Christmas Tree Forest, the Portland Parade of Lights and the Christmas in Ingleside Parade and Tree Lighting
  • Meet Santa: the Tree Lighting and Christmas in Portland Celebration, Breakfast with Santa at Portland Community Center and Breakfast with Santa at Ingleside Fire Department
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Portland Parade of Lights (December 7), the Aransas Pass and Sinton illuminated parades (December 3) and the Ingleside parade (December 4)
  • Trains: no train rides in town; The Polar Express movie night on December 22
  • Season: November 27 to January 3
